         # not a data type (e.g. a column named dtype in a pandas DataFrame)
         dtype_orig = None
 
+    # check if the object contains several dtypes (typically a pandas
+    # DataFrame), and store them. If not, store None.
+    dtypes_orig = None
+    if hasattr(array, "dtypes") and hasattr(array.dtypes, '__array__'):
+        dtypes_orig = np.array(array.dtypes)
+        # if all dtypes are the same, more general checks are not needed and
+        # simplify accordingly, treating it as if the array itself had a
+        # single dtype (as is the case for e.g. a homogeneous
+        # pandas.DataFrame). This allows check_array to detect a dtype
+        # change (e.g. object -> float64) and issue the expected
+        # DataConversionWarning when warn_on_dtype=True.
+        if all(dtype_item == dtypes_orig[0] for dtype_item in dtypes_orig):
+            dtype_orig = dtypes_orig[0]

     if dtype_numeric:
